answer: Random peer-review audit stops bulk forgery. A newcomer posts a 500 POA bond; a beacon randomly assigns three established auditors who view its history through a prism: past attestations, referral links, proof of real tasks. A failed audit slashes the bond and starts a spiral of re-audits, each costlier. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 600 = 60,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and joins an oasis of verified peers, its rewards never diluted.
